Ops.Name: tt_seek
Ops.Doc: move the program's reads to the state round A left, as if it ran in the block after A. A the round the program started at returns to its own state
Ops.DocExtra: POST /v2/query only (non-standard fork feature); simulate and blocks refuse a program with it. The txns of the program's group then read A+1 as their FirstValid and LastValid, as do the inner txns it sends, and FirstValidTime the timestamp of A; an inner txn's FirstValidTime fails once a later seek's block window lacks A. Costs 2200 more the first time the call reaches A. Fails if A is after the query round, if the call reaches more than max-seek-rounds rounds, if the node has no state of A, or between `itxn_begin` and `itxn_submit`.

Ops.Name: tt_acct_change
Ops.Doc: round X and status Y of the first change of account A's base record (balance, status, keys and totals, not its holdings, local states or params) between rounds B and C
Ops.DocExtra: POST /v2/query only (non-standard fork feature), on a node that keeps history; simulate and blocks refuse a program with it. Its last two args are the range's ends, from and to, inclusive: it searches oldest first when from <= to, else newest first. Status: 0 no change, 1 created, 2 changed, 3 deleted. Costs 20 more for each version it examined. Fails if from or to is after the query round or before the history's first round.

Ops.Name: tt_global_key_change
Ops.Doc: round X and status Y of the first change of key B of app A's global state between rounds C and D, and Z its new value (0 if deleted or unchanged)

Its last two args are the range's ends, from and to, inclusive: it searches oldest first when from <= to, else newest first. Status: 0 no change, 1 created, 2 changed, 3 deleted. Costs 20 more for each version it examined. Fails if from or to is after the query round or before the history's first round. A search reads at most max-scan-step-bytes of history: then status is 4, and X the round to resume from, as from. The searches of a call read at most max-call-scan-bytes in all; a search once they are spent fails the call.
